source.quote: Braiins je česká technologická firma zaměřená na bitcoinovou těžbu, která vznikla v roce 2011.

hq_country.note: Company described as Czech; location of any investment team not stated.

type.note: Operating bitcoin mining company making occasional corporate investments; no investor self-description found.

source.quote: In September 2024, Braiins acquired a 15% stake in Firefish, a bitcoin-backed peer-to-peer lending platform.

meta.candidate_source: tech.eu top investors Czech Republic H1 2025
meta.notes: Braiins is an operating bitcoin-mining technology company, not a fund; corporate investor at most. Legal entity and IČO not found (website has no imprint; one registry search found nothing). Firefish stake: blog page says ~1M USD for 15% in Sept 2024, round headline 1.8M USD vs 2M in body; role not stated on the fetched page (cc.cz reportedly calls Braiins lead, not fetched). Braiins also acquired New York commodity fund CAMMS Capital in April 2026 (Seznam Zpravy 2026-05-19): whole-company acquisition, not recorded as venture activity. Braiins home page names CAMMS Capital and Firefish as 'backed by Braiins'.
